record.question: What is the amount of transfer grant admissible to the spouse transferred later, when the transfer of both the husband and wife is within 60 days?
record.explanation: Under the transfer-grant provisions applied to Government servants (DoE O.M. No. 19030/1/2017-E.IV, followed in Mizoram service rules), where both husband and wife are Government servants and both are transferred, no transfer grant is admissible to the spouse transferred later when the second transfer takes place within a period of 60 days of the other's transfer. The 50% rate applies only when the second transfer falls after 60 days but within six months, so the distractor is excluded here. Source verified on the printed page (OCR of LDE Jr. Grade of MSS Paper-III, July-2025, Q.30).
